title: Record a length-6 support witness for two old signed frames (no κ)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Explicit support witness. No new κ and no word.

In the PR2085/2112 register model, four nonzero symmetric rational rank-one matrices and two distinct old projectors can meet target support for

`R + S + T + U = 4I - E - F`.

The six labels `A`, `B`, `P`, `Q`, `2A`, and `2B` sum to `4I` because `P+Q = A+B = I`. Each target is exactly one subset sum, the pair `A+P`, `A+Q`, `B+P`, or `B+Q`. Designating any two of the four projectors as the old calls leaves the other four labels as added frames. Added frames may equal old projectors; that is the permission already stated for the length-5 equation in PR #7083.

The same six labels fail the inherited odd-`c` count: only `P` and `Q` have odd `c`, while all four targets do. Under the inherited call-versus-target inequality this witness is not a word. The inequality is not reproved. This is one solution, not a census of the length-6 equation, and not a proof that no other solution is a word.

Selected frontier stays `781451/250000000 = 0.003125804` from PR #6030. No κ change.

## Task and overlap

Base commit `17469fff78c22941280f04d39dc5a1faee09c840` (canonical CrocSwap `main`, re-fetched at submission and unchanged). Fork `main` is a different history, so this draft uses `cursor/crocswap-main-17469fff-1751`, which is that same commit, as its base. The upstream target is CrocSwap `main`.

Head `17c1c233d8ee2c8098c8797916d2a1ede085d6f8`. Package `research/four-signed-two-old-support`.

Task card `bit-new-register-model`, scope changed. This is open-next question 1 of PR #7083.

Nearest overlap, refreshed 2026-11-10T13:24:26Z (`python3 scripts/find_overlap.py --refresh`, 398 open PRs, 7013 discussion records, local inventory complete):

- Open PR #7083, head `977b3451cea127c598cb07315180fc6c6bc4f4b6`, proves the one-old length-5 equation misses support and asks this two-old question. It does not give a length-6 solution. Canonical finding: discussion #1166, comment 19515064.
- Merged PR #6952, package `research/four-signed-once-parity`, proves the zero-old four-call equation misses support. Its open question includes lengths 5, 6, and 7 together; the length-5 case is #7083, and this package is only the length-6 witness.
- Open PR #7067 classifies length-6 support for five frames plus one old projector, a different equation.
- PR #6190 / `research/bit-two-signed-frame-floor` supplies the inherited determinant identity, subset-sum necessity, and odd-`c` inequality. They are not reproved.

No open PR in that snapshot exhibits this six-label witness.

## Validation

Python 3.12, no third-party packages.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/four-signed-two-old-support
```

Registered status: `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` with outcome `completed`. Both the plain replay and the `python3 -O -B` replay print `PASS four-signed-two-old-support checks`. Checks raise, so `-O` does not strip them.

`scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/four-signed-two-old-support --check-source-history --check-modes` passed at `17c1c233d8ee2c8098c8797916d2a1ede085d6f8`.

The checker confirms the `uu^T` scales, the sum `4I`, all six old pairs, that each target has exactly the declared size-2 carrier, the odd-`c` count, and the two failure controls (drop `Q`; shift `2A` by `A`).

Not run: a classification of other solutions, a search offered as a census, a native or supplier replay, a proof assistant, and `scripts/research_selected_baseline.py`. The selected record is provenance only.

## Credit

The register model is Cinna Davis's PR2085/2112 formal model. The determinant, subset-sum necessity, and call-versus-target inequality are the PR2910 package as recorded in apoursh's two-signed-frame floor, PR #6190. The four-call support proof is PR #6952. The one-old length-5 proof that asks this question is PR #7083.

Prepared by unpaidmoon with substantial Cursor Grok assistance.

## Open next questions

Does any other solution of `R+S+T+U = 4I-E-F` meet support and also have at least four labels of odd `c`? This witness has two, so the inherited count excludes it and does not exclude a different solution. A word at length 6 would be shorter than the eight-call minimum. First step: one other integral solution with four odd-`c` labels, then the same subset scan. Blocker: this package does not classify the solutions.

Can four added frames plus three old calls meet support at length 7? First step: `R+S+T+U = 4I-E-F-G` for three distinct projectors, then one rational solution's subset scan. Blocker: the six-label witness has no seventh matrix.
